feeds.title: Meeting C++ Blog
feeds.description: Read about the C++, Qt, ISO Standardization, and other C++ related things on the Meeting C++ blog. Since 2012, Meeting C++ is Europe's leading C++ Conference and also platform for C++ User Groups.

feeds.title: C++ Stories
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date with Modern C++. My name is Bartlomiej Filipek. I am a software developer from the beautiful city Cracow in Southern Poland. This is my technical blog.

feeds.title: C++ Team Blog
feeds.description: C++ tutorials, C and C++ news, and information about Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, and Vcpkg from the Microsoft C++ team.

feeds.title: Daniel Lemire Blog
feeds.description: Daniel Lemire is a computer science professor at the University of Quebec (TELUQ) in Montreal. His research is focused on software performance and data engineering. He programs in C, C++, Java, JavaScript, Python, Swift and Go. He works primarily in an open-source setting.

feeds.title: The CLion Blog
feeds.description: A cross platform IDE for C and C++. JetBrains is a cutting-edge software vendor specializing in the creation of intelligent development tools, including IntelliJ IDEA - the leading Java IDE, and the Kotlin programming language.

feeds.title: Vorbrodt's C++ Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I am Martin Vorbrodt, I am your host on this blog. I have been a professional programmer for about 20 years but coding has been a passion of mine for over 30. My main interests are systems, low-level, and generic programming, as well as high performance, clean, and concise C++ code.

feeds.title: Arthur O'Dwyer Blog
feeds.description: Stuff mostly about C++. I started this blog on 2018-03-13 so that I'd have a place to dump short essays on topics that seem to come up a lot in the discussion about C++. I might occasionally say things that aren't about C++, too.

feeds.title: Sandor Dargo's Blog
feeds.description: Sandor Dargo writes about C++, software development, books, and stoic philosophy applied to software craftsmanship.

feeds.title: Marius Bancila's Blog
feeds.description: My name is Marius Bancila, I am a software architect, author, and speaker from Timisoara, Romania. Since 2006 I have been recognized as a Microsoft MVP for VC++ and later Development Technologies for my online and offline activities focused on Microsoft technologies and development tools and particularly Visual C++.

feeds.title: Barry Revzin
feeds.description: A blog by Barry Revzin - a C++ programmer and swimming current analyzer.

feeds.title: Sutter's Mill
feeds.description: Herb Sutter on software development. He is an author, chair of the ISO C++ standards committee, and native languages architect at Microsoft.

feeds.title: Andrzej's C++ Blog
feeds.description: I am Andrzej. I started this blog because I wanted to share my knowledge on both practical aspects of programming in C++ and some theoretical background on C++ design and current evolution. I have been developing commercial applications in C++ since 2004 and have been studying the progress of the ISO C++ Standards Committee. I believe some of the posts may prove useful to C++ programmers.

feeds.title: Shafik Yaghmour's Blog
feeds.description: Blog about C++, C, Undefined Behavior, and Compilers.

feeds.title: Fluent C++
feeds.description: My name is Jonathan Boccara. I've been working as a software engineer on large codebases for 10 years. Fluent C++ contains some 450 articles (including guest posts) about writing expressive code in general, and in C++ in particular.

feeds.title: Belay the C++ Blog
feeds.description: This blog aims to enlighten the reader about bad yet often seen practices in C++, explanations on how it is bad, and ways to avoid it. You will occasionally see articles about good practices instead of bad ones, and sometimes strange-yet-interesting behavior.

feeds.title: Foonathan Blog
feeds.description: Thoughts from a C++ library developer. Jonathan is a student whose hobby is C++: he writes open-source projects, blog about them plus more, and give talks.

feeds.title: Simplify C++!
feeds.description: I am Arne - a C++ enthusiast. As of today, I live in Hamburg, work in software development for several years now, and have had my share of Cpp and other programming problems myself. Most of the posts you will see on this blog are either based on things I have experienced myself or are answers to questions that have popped up on the team I work on or on the web.

feeds.title: The Coding Nest
feeds.description: I am a mainly C++ programmer that used to work with safety-critical, hard and soft real-time systems, but lately, I have been working on a research project at FEE CTU. I also happen to teach C++ at my university.

feeds.title: Craft::cpp
feeds.description: Blog about modern C++ and software design. Marin Peko is a software engineer with focus on high-performance, clean and expressive code.

feeds.title: Lesley Lai's Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am Lesley Lai, a Software Engineering Intern at Trimble SketchUp and a Computer Science and Applied Mathematics undergraduate student at the University of Colorado at Boulder. My primary interests include Computer Graphics and Programming Language theories. I love to code in various programming languages, though I am particularly fond of C++.

feeds.title: The ReSharper C++ Blog
feeds.description: Latest Tips and tricks on C++. JetBrains is a cutting-edge software vendor specializing in the creation of intelligent development tools, including IntelliJ IDEA - the leading Java IDE, and the Kotlin programming language.

feeds.title: Preshing on Programming
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jeff Preshing, Canadian computer programmer. This is where I write about programming-related stuff. I try to keep it technical and tend to focus on C++ and Python.

feeds.title: Andreas Fertig Blog
feeds.description: Andreas Fertig is an embedded software developer, trainer, and speaker from Stuttgart. He enjoys exploring the depth of the language and sharing his knowledge.

feeds.title: Modernes C++ Blog
feeds.description: Training, Coaching, and Technology Consulting. Rainer is an author of a few C++ books, speaker, and blogger.

feeds.title: bitwizeshift on software
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Matthew Rodusek, a software developer from Waterloo, Ontario. I am an embedded developer by day, C++ template meta-programmer by night. When I see a problem that does not yet have a solution, I develop it - and try to release it to the open-source community (where possible) through my GitHub.
